story.title: Our Story
story.body: Deep Group began as a small construction firm with a simple vision: to create quality homes at accessible prices. Over the years, that beginning has grown into a real estate group with 30+ completed projects across residential, commercial and industrial developments. With every project, we’ve grown our experience. Today, we continue to carry that experience into the next generation of Deep Group projects.
